newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan Deputies pass crucial labor law reform.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan Deputies pass crucial labor law reform.

text.p: Venezuela's Chamber of Deputies approved late Wednesday crucial reforms of the Labor Law, part of a wider package of social security reforms, legislators said.

The bill passes to the Senate Tuesday for a final discussion. Only the union-based Radical Cause party opposed the motion in the deputies' chamber and the bill was passed with only slight modifications.

The reform, heralded as an astonishing breakthrough in labor relations when agreed to by a tripartite commission of government, union and business leader in February, is expected to free up Venezuela's rigid labor markets. so boosting long-term productivity.
